title: Pioneer Museum

services.name: Railroad Exhibits
services.desc: This two-story building was originally the Western Motel’s restaurant, located west of the museum. Restoration of the building was completed in 1997. This building contains exhibits such as the Colorado Cannibal, dolls, musical instruments, pewter and silverware, photography equipment and photos, paintings, arrowhead and Native American artifacts, and an La Veta Hotel memorabilia is located behind the front desk. More pictures of the once grand hotel are hanging on the north wall of the main floor. blurb: A true hidden gem in Colorado!This museum was such a pleasant surprise - it’s like stepping into a time machine. The collection is incredibly well-curated with historic trains, old wagons, antique cars, and original buildings from Gunnison’s early days. You can tell everything is preserved with love and care. My kids loved exploring the train caboose and the old schoolhouse!
